name: RotterdamHaz
description: This dataset archive provides RotterdamHaz, an open benchmark dataset for hazmat road transport risk in the Rotterdam–Rijnmond area. It accompanies the manuscript RotterdamHaz: A Hazmat Road Transport Risk Benchmark for the Rotterdam–Rijnmond Port and Industrial Area. The deposit contains a directed OSM road network (35,843 nodes, 80,277 arcs) with ADR tunnel categories, Basisnet sections and the A24 toll, per-arc release frequencies (BRON, CBS, RBM II), CBS 100 m population rasters, arc-to-cell impact sets for four substances, gravity-model OD demand calibrated and cross-validated against Rijkswaterstaat VGS dangerous-goods counts, problem instances, baselines, QA and build code. Licences: database ODbL 1.0; rasters, parameters and documentation CC BY 4.0; code MIT (see LICENSES.md). Facilities are pseudonymised. Results are methodological, not a safety assessment. Citation Please cite this dataset archive as: Liu Q. RotterdamHaz: an open benchmark dataset for hazmat road transport risk. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23568109 Citation metadata are also provided in CITATION.cff. Please cite the accompanying manuscript when referring to the scientific findings.
